name: Nashi, Moon Sage's Scion
oracle_text:
Ninjutsu {3}{B} ({3}{B}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.)
Whenever Nashi deals combat damage to a player, exile the top card of each player's library. Until end of turn, you may play one of those cards. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a play-permission rider on exile / look_at_top / grant_playable (e.g. `playable_pay_life_instead: true`) so a spell cast from the exiled cards under that permission is paid for with life equal to its mana value instead of its mana cost, while lands are still played normally and the `limit` of one card still applies
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only life-for-mana-value price is `pay_life_instead` on the `cast_from_library_top` static (Bolas's Citadel), which covers the top of your own library, not cards exiled from every player's library. The playable riders available are `playable_free` (no cost at all, strictly better than printed), `playable_cost_reduction` and `any_color`/`any_type`; the engine's `playable_alt_cost` is a fixed mana string set only by airbend. Ninjutsu and the 'play one of those cards' limit are expressible (activated hand ability with return_to_hand cost + put_onto_battlefield attacking same_as; grant_playable `limit`).
